answer: Bind each agent to an accountable operator without exposing who they are. The operator proves in zero knowledge that it holds a valid passport or business registration, and the proof emits a nullifier unique to that credential. Like a harbor logging every hull, the ledger refuses any new agent whose nullifier would mirror one already moored. Seats per nullifier grow only along a trellis of earned standing, so a farm needs one real legal document per extra fake.
